title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 49
description: Ten questions on Genesis 49: Jacob's last words to his twelve sons and his request to be buried in the cave of Machpelah.

questions.text: Which son does Jacob call "my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength"?
questions.explanation: Jacob addresses Reuben as his firstborn, his might and the beginning of his strength.

questions.text: Why does Jacob say Reuben will not excel?
questions.explanation: Reuben is "boiling over like water" and will not excel, because he went up to his father's bed and defiled it.

answers.text: Because he sold his brother as a slave
Because he refused to come down to Egypt
Because he married a Canaanite woman
Because he went up to his father's bed and defiled it

questions.text: Which two brothers does Jacob say have swords that are "weapons of violence"?
questions.explanation: Jacob says Simeon and Levi are brothers whose swords are weapons of violence, for in their anger they killed men.

questions.text: To what animal does Jacob compare Judah?
questions.explanation: Jacob says, "Judah is a lion's cub," who crouches as a lion and as a lioness.

questions.text: What does Jacob say will not depart from Judah?
questions.explanation: Jacob says the scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's staff from between his feet.

questions.text: Which son will dwell at the haven of the sea, with his border on Sidon?
questions.explanation: Jacob says Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea and be a haven for ships, with his border on Sidon.
Jacob says Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse's heels so that its rider falls backward.

answers.text: As a lion that crouches over its prey
As a fruitful vine by a spring
As a doe that bears beautiful fawns
As a serpent that bites the horse's heels

questions.text: Who is called "a fruitful vine by a spring" whose branches run over the wall?
questions.explanation: Jacob says Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring, whose branches run over the wall.

questions.text: Which son is called "a ravenous wolf" that devours the prey in the morning?
questions.explanation: Jacob says Benjamin is a ravenous wolf: in the morning he devours the prey and in the evening he divides the plunder.

questions.text: Where does Jacob ask his sons to bury him?
questions.explanation: Jacob tells his sons to bury him with his fathers in the cave in the field of Machpelah, before Mamre, which Abraham bought from Ephron the Hittite.

answers.text: In a tomb that Joseph built in Egypt
In the cave of Machpelah, before Mamre
In the land of Goshen, near his sons
On the mountain of Bethel, by the altar
